task_definition.title: P3γ: feature-provenance round-trip .ri example + two-way boundary test (focused-H gate)
task_definition.description:
PRD: docs/prds/naming-convergence/P3-feature-provenance-query-surface.md task γ (LEAF, CI signal — the focused-H integration gate). Manifest binding: §γ.

Commit the charter's `FeatureProvenanceSelectorsV2` round-trip example AND implement the §6 two-way boundary matrix (the seam between the query surface and the populated provenance substrate; closes G2 via the C-as-integration-gate pattern).

1. .ri example (examples/…/feature_provenance_selectors_v2.ri): `let base = box(...)` → `let g = fillet(base, edge, r)` → `feature(base)` / `feature(g)` → `created_by_feature(g, feature(g))` vs `created_by_feature(g, feature(base))` give DISTINCT face sets. Must `reify eval`/`check` green in CI (file-exists + content signal).

2. §6 two-way boundary test (crates/reify-eval/tests/):
   Producer side — primitive round-trip (feature(base) → created_by_feature resolves the box face set, non-empty); FILLET DISCRIMINATION (created_by_feature over feature(g) vs feature(base) → disjoint & non-empty face sets — production-backed via populate_local_feature_op, engine_build.rs:920); split stability (split_by_feature over a mod_history-bearing path — OQ#5: morph/split path morph_stage_b.rs:732, or scope the row noting the gap); off-provenance FAIL-CLOSED (structured diagnostic + Value::Undef, never silent empty/panic).
   Consumer side — explicit-projection type error (pass a Geometry where a Feature is required → construct-time `reify check` error, no implicit coercion); kind discipline (Selector(Face) to a face: param ok; non-Face → kind error); feature() whole-body vs sub-shape both resolve.

3. Document the three new functions (feature, created_by_feature, split_by_feature) in docs/reify-stdlib-reference.md.

G6 GUARD: assert fillet discrimination QUALITATIVELY (disjoint & non-empty) — do NOT pin a brittle exact face count; pin counts only after observing the realized fixture (PRD OQ#4). Avoid a guessed-count RED test.

User-observable signal (LEAF, CI): committed examples/…/feature_provenance_selectors_v2.ri that reify eval/check runs green (file-exists + content) AND a committed boundary-test file under crates/reify-eval/tests/ whose §6 rows all pass (fillet discrimination disjoint & non-empty; off-provenance fail-closed; explicit-projection type error).
Consumer: the integration gate itself (proves the query surface ↔ populated-provenance contract end-to-end); the example is a user-facing artifact.
Modules touched: reify-eval (tests/), examples/, docs. metadata.files=[] — new example + new boundary-test file spanning the reify-eval test tree, acquired by BRE (mirrors P0 γ / P1 ε).
Prereqs: α, β.
